sloka: सह तार अंगदाभ्याम् तु सहसा हनुमान् कपिः ।सुग्रीवेण यथा उद्दिष्टम् तम् देशम् उपचक्रमे ॥४-४८-१॥
transliteration: saha tāra aṁgadābhyām tu sahasā hanumān kapiḥ ।sugrīveṇa yathā uddiṣṭam tam deśam upacakrame ॥4-48-1॥

translations.english: Hanuman, the monkey accompanied by Tara and Angada proceeded as instructed by Sugriva in the (South) direction.
